best_for: Producers and performers on Windows or Mac who need one specific version of Live, such as the one a project was made in, or who want to try Suite free for 30 days before buying.

points.title: Windows and Mac only
points.text: Ableton's trial page says Live is available on Mac or Windows. There is no Linux version, and the Windows downloads here are 64-bit only.

points.title: An Ableton account is required
points.text: Ableton's download archive says you need an Ableton account to use any version of Live, including Live Lite and the free trial. The links on this page go straight to Ableton's servers, but running Live still needs the account.

points.title: The trial is the full Suite
points.text: Ableton offers Live 12 Suite free for 30 days, with no credit card needed. Its downloads are about 4.5 GB on Windows (64-bit) and 5.5 GB on Mac (universal), so plan for the space and the time.

points.title: Four editions, with real limits
points.text: On Ableton's shop page, Intro is described as 16 tracks and 5+ GB of sounds, Standard as 38+ GB of sounds with more instruments and effects, and Suite as 71+ GB with Max for Live and all instruments and effects. Lite is not on the shop page, but its downloads are still served.

points.title: What Intro caps
points.text: Ableton's current edition comparison lists Intro at 16 audio and MIDI tracks, 16 scenes and 2 send and return tracks, against unlimited tracks and scenes and 12 sends in Standard and Suite. It also lists 16 audio inputs and outputs for Intro and 256 for the others.

points.title: Windows gets a ZIP, not a setup program
points.text: Every Windows download here is a ZIP archive. You extract it and run what is inside, so the file you download does not change your PC by itself.

points.title: Mac builds differ by version
points.text: The Live 11 and Live 12 Mac downloads are universal, so they run on both Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Live 10 has a single 64-bit Mac build, named with a _64 suffix.

points.title: Older versions are kept here
points.text: This page lists Live 12, 11 and 10, every version with its release notes and a download for each edition. Live 9 and earlier are not covered.
